items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: He said, this is Dr. Nelson's song.

ctx.x: No. No. No. No. No. No.

He said, this is Dr. Nelson's song. Oh, I used to play Louie Nelson and George Nelson. One played trampone and one played saxophone. Yeah, me and Louie, we used to play together a long time. It was Kit Harris then when we were playing together.
